Couple wanted for Uttarakhand murder arrested in J&K

Jammu and Kashmir Police have arrested a couple from Katra, who were reportedly on the run after a murder case in Uttarakhand. The couple, identified as being from Haryana, were apprehended at a hotel in Reasi district. This arrest follows a search for the individuals in connection with the crime in Uttarakhand.
